idea-plugin.name: Maekom API Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom API Runner — Open-source (Apache License 2.0) Spring Boot API Scenario Runner & PSI Auto-Sampler for IntelliJ IDEA.
  • 🌶️ Gutter chili icon on Spring Web controller endpoints (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping, @RequestMapping)
  • Auto-extracts @RequestParam, @ModelAttribute & POJO/record fields into a dedicated Params tab with Javadoc/@Schema/@Parameter descriptions, and generates JSON samples from @RequestBody DTOs & records
  • Multi-step scenario chaining with Jayway JsonPath extraction, built-in Extract Guide, one-click Response JSON field extraction, Fail-Fast policy, scenario Rename, dirty-check confirmation, and local secret separation (.maekom/secrets.local.json)
  • Built-in live dynamic variables ({{$isoTimestamp}}, {{$timestamp}}, {{$timestampMs}}, {{$kstNow}}, {{$kstDate}}, {{$kstCompact}}, {{$kstIso}}, {{$uuid}}) with a non-modal Variables Cheat Sheet and right-click variable insertion menus
  • Copy as cURL for both single steps and full multi-step scenarios, responsive wrapping toolbars, built-in KO / EN language switch, instant cancellation, and non-JSON response safety

License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (Open Source — maekom-hub/maekom-api-runner)
